title: NEXT_PUBLIC_ values are baked in at build
why_it_matters: Changing one in Vercel does nothing until you redeploy.
explanation: Next.js replaces NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables with their real values while building. The browser code contains the final text, not a lookup. So after changing one, trigger a new build. Server-only variables are read at runtime on the server.
try_it: Change a public variable, redeploy, and confirm the new value appears.
